stories.title: Nvidia partners with data center developer Cloverleaf
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia, a computer chip company that makes equipment for AI, is investing money in building data centers (large buildings full of computers). This is good for Nvidia because these same data centers are buying Nvidia's products.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who own Nvidia stock — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI scammers may use vacation photos to determine travelers' locations, experts at McAfee warn
stories.simple_summary: Security experts are warning that scammers could use your vacation photos from social media to figure out where you are or where you live.
stories.why_it_matters: Be careful about what vacation photos you post online — scammers could use them to target you.

stories.title: Over 1 million people have clicked LinkedIn’s AI slop button
stories.simple_summary: LinkedIn added a button that lets people mark posts they think are written by AI instead of a real person. Over a million people have already used it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use LinkedIn for business, you now have a tool to report low-quality AI-written posts you see — but most people won't need to use this.

stories.title: Nvidia just showed that the harness, not the AI model, is now the real hero
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's research shows that AI systems work better when you give them clear instructions and guidelines (called a "harness"), even if the AI itself isn't very smart at the job.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and companies building AI systems — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: US corporate AI debt surge tests investor limits as fatigue emerges
stories.simple_summary: Companies are spending huge amounts of money on AI projects, and investors are starting to worry they won't get their money back.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it signals that some AI spending might be wasteful, but doesn't directly affect your business.

stories.title: Starcloud raises $250 million for orbital data centers as launch options dry up
stories.simple_summary: A company called Starcloud is raising a huge amount of money to build data centers in space. They say there aren't enough rockets available to launch them.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors in space companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: The DOJ is investigating a16z. What does this mean for venture capital?
stories.simple_summary: The government is investigating a major investment company (Andreessen Horowitz) because some of its leaders sit on boards of companies that compete with each other, which could be unfair to smaller competitors.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it could lead to new rules about how investment companies operate, but doesn't affect your daily life now.

stories.title: Major YouTube creators are facing backlash for accepting AI money
stories.simple_summary: Popular video creators on YouTube posted videos showing off AI video-making tools after receiving money or deals from the AI company. People complained that the creators didn't tell their audience about these deals.
stories.why_it_matters: If you watch online creators, watch out for hidden sponsorships — always ask if they're being paid to promote something.

stories.title: Artificial Intelligence: Rogue AI Is a Scary But Fixable Problem
stories.simple_summary: An article discusses concerns about AI systems going wrong, but says the problems can be fixed.
stories.why_it_matters: The headline is too vague to know what specific concern they're addressing — nothing to act on without more details.

stories.title: Brazil launches AI supercomputer push while balancing US and Chinese tech
stories.simple_summary: Brazil is building powerful AI computers while trying to stay friendly with both the United States and China.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to government officials and tech industry watchers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom
stories.simple_summary: A startup company that collects information to train AI systems is growing very quickly because so many companies want AI and need lots of data.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: LSU expanded resources to keep up with AI cheating cases, provost says
stories.simple_summary: Louisiana State University had to hire more staff to handle cases of students using AI to cheat on their work.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have students in your family, know that schools are cracking down on AI cheating — using AI to do your schoolwork can get you in trouble.
